from pyod.models.iforest import IForest
from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
import numpy as np

model = SentenceTransformer('all-MiniLM-L6-v2')

# Load samples (one per line, skip comments, last one is the outlier)
with open('samples.txt') as f:
    samples = [line.strip() for line in f if line.strip() and not line.startswith('#')]

assert len(samples) >= 6, "Need at least 6 samples"
assert '???' not in samples[-1], "Replace ??? with outlier sample for pyod/IsolationForest detection"
assert len(samples[-1].split()) >= 120, "Outlier sample needs 120+ words"

embeddings = model.encode(samples)
detector = IForest(contamination=1/len(samples))
detector.fit(embeddings)

# Last sample should be detected as outlier (label=1)
predictions = detector.predict(embeddings)
assert predictions[-1] == 1, "Last sample should be outlier"
assert sum(predictions[:-1]) == 0, "Other samples should be normal"

print("Anomaly detection test passed!")
```
